title: Uruguayan Hash with Roasted Potatoes
description: A hearty and flavorful Uruguayan-inspired breakfast dish featuring roasted potatoes and crispy hash.
instructions: Toss the potatoes with melted butter, salt, and pepper until coated.
Spread the potatoes on a baking sheet and roast for 20-25 minutes or until tender.
In a pan, heat some oil over medium heat. Add the chopped hash and cook until crispy.
Remove the potatoes from the oven and sprinkle with ground nutmeg.
Serve the roasted potatoes with crispy hash on top.
